root_cause.text: The failure to flush pending packets enqueued in nfqueue that reference helper or timeout policy objects when an xt_CT template rule is destroyed, resulting in use-after-free or other memory safety issues when those objects are removed (e.g., module unload or timeout policy deletion).
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that templates can refer to helpers and timeout policies that may disappear while packets are queued in nfqueue, and the patch adds `nf_queue_nf_hook_drop(par->net)` inside `xt_ct_tg_destroy` when either helper or timeout is set, to drop those enqueued packets before the associated objects are freed.
